root_causes.description: Extreme p99 latency spike (z>1000) with baseline 1.98ms rising to 2.566s window mean, indicating downstream or infrastructure issue affecting currency service
Extreme cpu usage spike (z>1000) and memory pressure (z=+122.56) indicating process-level resource exhaustion causing downstream latency
Significant memory pressure (z=+10.97) combined with latency spike (z=+7.88) suggesting resource contention affecting payment processing

remediation_steps: Investigate currency service dependencies and downstream database latency, consider circuit breaker or timeout adjustment
Restart recommendation pods to relieve memory pressure, review for memory leak in recommendation service
Add memory limits and requests for payment service, investigate potential leak causing z=+10.97 memory spike
